method: Repairs are questions one-shot got wrong and this row got right. Breaks are the reverse. The paired sign test is an exact two-sided binomial test on those discordant questions, success probability 1/2. The 95% interval is a percentile bootstrap of exact match: 10000 draws with replacement from these questions, seed 42, percentiles 2.5 and 97.5.
